sections.title: Innovation, Change, and Entrepreneurship
sections.description: Designed for students with a serious interest in entrepreneurship and being entrepreneurial, this course is based around action. Building on the skills of Management 2300, every class session is built around an experience where you have to put learning into practice, including the multiple simulations and by using AI. The goal is to constantly challenge you to deal with entrepreneurial or innovative experiences, as you learn to navigate complex and changing environments on the fly, applying what you learned to a variety of scenarios. This class is built to be challenging and will require a desire to deal with ambiguous and shifting circumstances, where the meaning is not always clear upfront. MGMT 2300 is recommended but not required.
